name: Typist
description: Types the clipboard, a saved snippet or a recent clipboard entry once, keystroke by keystroke, with pauses after line breaks and punctuation: a bar button and a picker panel. Keys go through haseen's ydotool shim into the session's Hyprland (no ydotoold). Adopted from t1nk33r.typist (sanjuanjor/typist, MIT); off by default

delayMs.description: Pause between keystrokes in ms (at least 5)

newlineDelayMs.description: Pause after each line break in ms

startupDelayMs.description: Wait before typing starts, so a held hotkey can be released and the panel can hand focus back

maxClipboardBytes.description: Text larger than this is refused, not typed

recentCount.description: Recent text entries from haseen.clipboard's history (cliphist) the picker lists; 0 hides the section. Typist stores none of them

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.typist (state, select, activate, filter, pin, remove) while the panel is open
